main_text.p: 1. Reg.3.9. & Levit.19.32. Plur. סִבְרִין Genef. 49.10.in Tar. Hier.& ab alia forma סְבִירִין, Levit.19.32.in Jon.
סַבַר Ch. Afpectus, quando cum Nomine אַף Facies, Vultus, conjungitur.
סַבִיר Ch. Afpectabilis, fimiliter cum Nomine אַף junctum, ut Jobi 22.8.
סַגָּא, סַגִּי, & סַגֵּי Ch. & Syr. Multum effe, Multiplicari, Augeri, Crefcere: Infinit. לְמִסְגֵּי Ad deficiendum, pro לְמִשְׁגֵּי, Judic. 21.3. Aphel אַסְגֵּי Multiplicare, Augere.

סַגֵּי, סַגִּיא Ch. & Syr. Multus, copiosus, amplus, & adverbialiter: Multum, plurimum, satis: סַגִּי ܣܓܝ Multò magis. Plur. סַגִּיאִין. סַגִּיאָא: Syr. ܣܓܝ : Foemin. סַגִּיאָרֵי, ܣܓܝ, סַגִּיאָתָא, Multa. Plur. סַגִּיאָן, סַגִּיאָתָא; & ܣܓܝ, Johan.11.47.absque ܐ.
סוּגִּי Chald. Idem, Jobi 37.23: & cum inserto סוּגָּאִי, Prov.5.23.
סַגִּיאָרֵי Ch. Idem. Conftr. סַגִּיאַת, Thren.1.5.
סַגִּיו סַגִּיוּתָא סַגִּיוּת סַגִּיאוּרֵי Ch. & Syr. Idem.
סַגִּיא Chal. Sepes, fepimentum, maceria, Numer.22. 24.in T.Hier. Fomam hinc habet, fed fignificationem a סִיג, ut & fequens.
סַגִּיתָא Ch. Idem, Esth.3.3.in Targ. fec.

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew-letter words are partly illegible in the scan (vowel points and forms of the Syriac lines are uncertain); the Syriac forms are approximated. Printed Hebrew/Chaldee forms transcribed as best read.
